title: ASP.NET tracing is exposed (/trace.axd)
summary: The ASP.NET trace handler answers here, which shows the details of recent requests including headers, cookies and session values.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Application Trace") and body_contains("Request Details") and body_contains("Trace Information") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Turn tracing off in production, and never leave trace.axd reachable.
